the green season: the second line taken, the race's line won, the two reds met, the parallel panel (faces to the reader); the season's question over the green
the green at its height: the bull taken at the water, the crossing (the spirit hound's scent), the war's shape changed — the next line of both lists is the reading of the other's mark

the falling of the green: the after-cost paid, the kill-word read as a sign, THE KEEPERS' LINE SET (the watch craft), the voice spent at the deep edge, the want wakened patient — two lists over one country and only one of them can read

the deep country's second winter: the season of the watch, the second edge of the sign (the pale beast reading him), the watch-fold broken and a man killed, the WRONG FACE on the keepers' line, the hound's second reading, the aimed word paid for, the line turned south
the thaw: the south watch on the pale beast's chosen ground, the beast seen and counted, the hound's third reading, the paper held with no light for the box, the low country taken
the summer: the one print read, the pan made the watch, and he prints no more
the wet: the watch kept through the rain and gained no line, the wire took an ox, the low water watch set for summer, and he lived the wet on stone, leaving nothing

the dry, rebuilt s45: his drinking to the runs, the hound's nights watched from the rim, the kill at the run and the men at his shallows, and THE WATCH GOES HOME — the men walked south for the last time; the country is his

the quiet years as time-skip: the packs and the map of habit (the bank given up, kills never twice in a year), the country taking the men's marks back, the two long sleeps, the pale beast's roar gone out of the south, and THE NORTH ROAD BEGUN — the birdless hollow, the river-road, the far standing light, the pull nearer by the road walked

the road's first three years: the reversal, the craft reborn, the first deep meal (the rib-tear kept), the hunted week (the veiling's failure; the meat-tax lawed), and the pass country found — the road's first true obstacle, its held ground under watch from the high seat

the watch teaches the pass's hours (and the storm night closes the road); the old grazer's taking shows the middle; the crossing goes by the watch — inside the river at the south lip's bend; THE READING: the weight reads him like a hand over stones and lets him go (beneath notice, not mercy; the red thing risen under it and carried out by the walking); the road resumes north of the pass

two years: the dark under the leaves read and walked; the fern hall's price (the kill abandoned — ordinary or a question); the water the only unread ground; the deep meals and the growth (the quiet-sense born — a whole ground's attention felt thinning); the road bent around a sleeper's country, a standing light seen once; and on the rock spine THE LEAN — the pull settling east of north toward the far mountains; the road and the pull coming apart ahead

the parting (the tarrying; the last ordinary day; the ford); the water road (absence; the swimmer-kind night); the sinking gorge and the bad ground (the walker's two passes; the red thing held alone — no river to carry it out this time); the rising country (the falls chain; stone in the beds); the mountains seen (snow on the shoulders; the pull pointing at the highest whiteness); the shoulder of stone — unknown again, the old way of being his
